editorial:
Imagine a world where love is treated like a game of chess, and you are watching a rich young lady try every trick in the book to get a guy's attention. You will meet Wei-fang, a spoiled but funny girl who spends her time flirting with random suitors just to make her cousin Rongsheng jealous. The problem is that Rongsheng is way too serious for his own good. Instead of getting jealous, he just lectures her about how she should act. It is a classic romantic comedy setup with a lot of messy love triangles, including a sweet sister who loves in secret and a confused professor who gets way too excited about Wei-fang.

What really works here is the chaotic energy of the characters as they all clash in one house. You will love seeing the awkward tension and the funny fights that break out between the men. While the pacing feels a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is worth it because the characters are so relatable in their stubbornness.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Wen-ping and Prof Ho Chi-hua get into a huge fight over who gets to be with Wei-fang. The chaos finally forces Wei-fang to stop playing games and admit that she only ever wanted Rongsheng. Rongsheng tries to act distant and avoid the situation, but he eventually gives in to her persistence. The movie ends with the couple finally getting together after all the flirting and fighting.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school romantic comedies and love triangles.
